request.prompt: A mountain quail (Oreortyx pictus), a plump round ground bird like a small partridge, NOT a dove, NOT a songbird. One adult walking on the ground, side-on, body low and horizontal, a short thick neck, a very short rounded tail, short legs. Two long thin straight black plumes rising from the crown and leaning back over the nape. About 27 cm long. Slate blue-grey head, nape and breast; a chestnut throat outlined in white; chestnut flanks with bold white vertical bars; olive-brown back and wings; a short stout black bill. Realistic proportions. No base, no rock. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.
